futureGroupingRule: sessionScope first, then the directoryRole; no concrete directory or filename is generated now

directoryRoles.cloneUnit: one plan slot per actual session; keep unexecuted slots blank
doNotInherit: C1/C2/C3 conclusions do not satisfy C4

directoryRoles.cloneUnit: one wrapper per planned policy; fill a cloned record only, not the source wrapper
doNotInherit: one policy result never fills another policy or C4

directoryRoles.cloneUnit: new standalone observation per command per session for L3
doNotInherit: Designate or old menu return does not fill L3

directoryRoles.cloneUnit: a separate clone from the original blank object, not a renamed L3 result
doNotInherit: L3 visibility does not prove Add, fixed position or feedback

directoryRoles.cloneUnit: preserve expected metadata separately; clone runtimeRecord for one plannedCaseId per attempt
match requirement metadata and operator row by id; store evidence per prerequisite
doNotInherit: RESOURCE_LOOKUP does not remove six blocking prerequisites
C1/C2/C3 do not supply C4 prerequisites

directoryRoles.cloneUnit: one custody record per case/session scope, link related evidence
doNotInherit: schema validity does not fill operator integrity PASS

directoryRoles.cloneUnit: copy the seven-row readonly preflight as one independent future review set
doNotInherit: readonly preparation does not authorize recovery action

directoryRoles.cloneUnit: retain original ledger and matching preparation manifest/SHA as reference; never replace originals with results
doNotInherit: input material identity is not loaded runtime identity

rawNotFoundRule: An external search observation may describe NOT_FOUND; schema status remains UNVERIFIED/PASS/FAILED/BLOCKED and is assigned only with the required evidence. Do not add NOT_FOUND to the status enum.
requestIdRule: Record a real requestId only when the relevant callback exists; do not invent one for object-only L1 observations.
